args.body:
File: src/util/money.ts

Fix parsing of amounts for zero-decimal currencies (such as CLP) where dot is used as a thousands separator instead of a decimal separator, and handle thousands/decimal separators appropriately based on currency minor digits or locale formatting.
args.title: Correct amount parsing and formatting for zero-decimal currencies like CLP

args.body:
label: bug
file: src/util/money.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

`parseAmount` and related money utilities incorrectly treat dot as a decimal separator even for zero-decimal currencies like CLP, where dots are typically used as thousand separators (e.g. 12.500 meaning 12,500), causing amounts to be parsed a thousand times too small or rejected.
